exposure: Anti TPO antibody positive vs negative
cohort: 247 randomly selected antenatal patients at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, N.S.C.B. Medical College and Hospital Jabalpur [MP] from March 1st, 2021 to August 31st, 2022
finding: The prevalence of Anti TPO antibody was 11.7%, associated with a higher risk of various pregnancy complications including pre-eclampsia, preterm labor, and low birth weight in neonates.
mod_finding: 72.41% of Anti TPO positive pregnant women delivered vaginally while 27.61% delivered via cesarean section.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was recorded, with 58.63% of neonates of Anti TPO antibody positive pregnant women having low birth weight (1-2.5kg)
